title: Generation (qwen/lora_dataset/generation.json)
description: Shared edit prefix and optional negative for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 dataset rows. prompt is a complete sentence prepended to the ComfyUI edit instruction only; omitted from caption.txt. Axis slots follow it as a second sentence, joined in this order: expression, pose, setting, camera, lighting, style. Caption uses the same slot order after subject.name. Not Animagine quality/rating tags; no quality suffix.

prompt.description: Complete identity-preserving sentence for the ComfyUI edit prompt (e.g. Keep the person's identity, face, and body from the reference image.).

negative.description: Optional negative prompt. Natural language. The Qwen-Image-Edit official unused value is a single space in this file. Omit when unused; ComfyUI then receives a single space. There is no official semantic default. Has little effect when CFG is 1.
